newsitem.title: UK: Clean tanker rates firm, sentiment bullish.
newsitem.headline: Clean tanker rates firm, sentiment bullish.

text.p: Freight rates for oil product tankers remained firm in most regions, with good demand provoking bullish forward sentiment.

"All in all it is fair to say that most of the world's clean markets continued firm with increasing expectation that demand for balance of the year will remain active"," brokers E.A. Gibson said in their weekly report.

However, in the Middle East, quieter conditions prevailed, with rates to India around 10 worldscale points weaker due to slacker demand, but brokers expected rates for long-haul voyages to rise following an active week in the Singapore market.
Rates in the Mediterranean continued to firm with good demand outstripping availablity as bad weather, affecting several ports, continued to tie up tonnage.
A 29,000-tonne gas oil cargo from the Black Sea to the Med was booked at W185 with UKC options taking W190.

UK/Cont activity was also fairly busy but bookings were mainly for fuel oil tonnage. However, gas oil shipments from Ventspils took W165 for Oct 21 lifting and W175 for loading at the end of the month.
In the Caribbean rates were steady with 30,000-tonne cargoes pegged around W240-250.
